facts.fact: The EACO report, published by the EACO Secretariat in Kigali, covers Rwanda as one of the seven member states of the East African Communications Organisation, with data submitted by Rwanda's regulator RURA; it gives no date for Rwanda's membership, so the published date is used.

The EACO report publishes Rwanda's One Network Area cross-border voice figures for 2025: inbound 107.4 million minutes (+41.0%) and outbound 74.0 million minutes (+35.4%), and says roaming tariffs were reduced under the ONA Project.
